traits.name: Final Spite
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Effect The wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. It doesn't gain any temporary HP from drain life on this Strike.

traits.name: Drain Life
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); When the wight damages a living creature with its claw Strike, the wight gains 3 temporary Hit Points and the creature must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save or become drained 1. Further damage dealt by the wraith increases the amount of drain by 1 on a failed save to a maximum of drained 4.

traits.name: Wight Spawn
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); A living humanoid slain by a wight's claw Strike rises as a wight after 1d4 (1d4) rounds. This wight spawn is under the command of the wight that killed it. It doesn't have Drain Life or Wight Spawn and becomes clumsy 2 for as long as it is a wight spawn. If the creator of the wight spawn dies, the wight spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous wight; it regains its free will, gains Drain Life and Wight Spawn, and is no longer clumsy.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +12 Damage 1d6+4 (1d6+4) slashing plus drain life
